-- Test computing SCE per pointcloud record
SELECT 
  p.cloudregistry,
  sc.zoneref,
  CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric) as cover_pct,
  CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS numeric) as lap_pct,
  CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric) * (1 + (CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS numeric)/100) * (1 - CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric)/100)) as sce
FROM pointcloud p 
JOIN scans sc ON p.arcref = sc.arcref
LIMIT 5;

-- Build the full DPQ calculation
WITH 
-- Pointcloud metrics per record (linked to sites via scans)
pc_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.zoneref,
    p.cloudregistry,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric) as cover_pct,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS numeric) as lap_pct,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db' AS numeric) as noise_db,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm' AS numeric) as scan_resol_mm,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense' AS numeric) as point_dense,
    -- SCE = Coverage × (1 + (Overlap/100) × (1 - Coverage/100))
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric) * (1 + (CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS numeric)/100) * (1 - CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric)/100)) as sce
  FROM pointcloud p 
  JOIN scans sc ON p.arcref = sc.arcref
),

-- Mesh metrics per record (directly linked to sites)
mesh_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    m.zoneref,
    m.facetregistry,
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric) as facet_faces,
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS numeric) as facet_verts,
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric) as facet_res_mm,
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix' AS numeric) as tex_pix,
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm' AS numeric) as geom_delta_mm,
    -- MCR = Faces / (Verts × Res²) × 10³
    CASE WHEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS numeric) > 0 AND CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric) > 0
      THEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric) / (CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS numeric) * POWER(CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric), 2)) * 1000
      ELSE NULL END as mcr,
    -- TDI = Tex_Pix / (√Faces × Res) × 10⁻²
    CASE WHEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric) > 0 AND CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric) > 0
      THEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix' AS numeric) / (SQRT(CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric)) * CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric)) * 0.01
      ELSE NULL END as tdi,
    -- Geometric Accuracy = Geom_Delta_Mm
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm' AS numeric) as geom_accuracy
  FROM mesh m
),

-- Registration metrics per record (linked to sites via scans)
reg_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.zoneref,
    r.logregistry,
    CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm' AS numeric) as reg_accuracy_mm,
    CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm' AS numeric) as err_val_mm
  FROM registration r 
  JOIN scans sc ON r.arcref = sc.arcref
),

-- Aggregate SCE per site
site_sce AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(sce) as avg_sce
  FROM pc_metrics
  GROUP BY zoneref
),

-- Aggregate MFS per site (MFS = MCR × (TDI/10) × (1 + exp(-geom_accuracy)))
site_mfs AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    AVG(
      mcr * (tdi / 10.0) * (1 + EXP(-geom_accuracy))
    ) as avg_mfs
  FROM mesh_metrics
  WHERE mcr IS NOT NULL AND tdi IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),

-- Aggregate SQS per site
-- SRI = log10(Scan_Resol × 1000) / log10(Point_Dense) × 5
-- SQS = (10/SRI)^1.5 × (SCE/100) × (1 - Noise_Level/30)²
site_sqc AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    AVG(scan_resol_mm) as avg_scan_resol,
    AVG(point_dense) as avg_point_dense,
    AVG(noise_db) as avg_noise_db,
    AVG(sce) as avg_sce_calc
  FROM pc_metrics
  GROUP BY zoneref
),

site_sri AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    CASE 
      WHEN LOG10(avg_point_dense) != 0 AND avg_point_dense > 0
      THEN LOG10(avg_scan_resol * 1000.0) / LOG10(avg_point_dense) * 5
      ELSE NULL
    END as sri
  FROM site_sqc
),

site_sqs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.sri IS NOT NULL AND s.sri > 0
      THEN POWER(10.0 / s.sri, 1.5) * (sc.avg_sce_calc / 100.0) * POWER(1 - sc.avg_noise_db / 30.0, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END as sqs
  FROM site_sri s
  JOIN site_sqc sc ON s.zoneref = sc.zoneref
),

-- Aggregate RAR per site
-- RAR = Scan_Resol / (Reg_Accuracy × sqrt(1 + Err_Val / Reg_Accuracy))
site_reg AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    AVG(reg_accuracy_mm) as avg_reg_acc,
    AVG(err_val_mm) as avg_err_val
  FROM reg_metrics
  GROUP BY zoneref
),

site_rar AS (
  SELECT 
    r.zoneref,
    CASE 
      WHEN r.avg_reg_acc > 0
      THEN COALESCE(sc.avg_scan_resol, r.avg_reg_acc) / (r.avg_reg_acc * SQRT(1 + r.avg_err_val / r.avg_reg_acc))
      ELSE NULL
    END as rar
  FROM site_reg r
  LEFT JOIN site_sqc sc ON r.zoneref = sc.zoneref
),

-- Combine all site-level aggregates
site_combined AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.zoneref,
    ss.avg_sce,
    sm.avg_mfs,
    sq.sqs,
    sr.rar,
    sqc.avg_noise_db
  FROM site_sce ss
  JOIN site_mfs sm ON ss.zoneref = sm.zoneref
  JOIN site_sqs sq ON ss.zoneref = sq.zoneref
  JOIN site_rar sr ON ss.zoneref = sr.zoneref
  JOIN site_sqc sqc ON ss.zonetz = sqc.zonetz
)

-- Try computing everything at the individual record level first, then aggregate per site
-- Each pointcloud record links to a site via scans.arcref = pointcloud.arcref

WITH 
pc AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.zoneref,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric) as cover_pct,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS numeric) as lap_pct,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db' AS numeric) as noise_db,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm' AS numeric) as scan_resol_mm,
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense' AS numeric) as point_dense,
    -- SCE
    CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric) * (1 + (CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS numeric)/100) * (1 - CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS numeric)/100)) as sce
  FROM pointcloud p 
  JOIN scans sc ON p.arcref = sc.arcref
),

mesh AS (
  SELECT 
    m.zoneref,
    CASE WHEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS numeric) > 0 AND CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric) > 0
      THEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric) / (CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS numeric) * POWER(CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric), 2)) * 1000
      ELSE NULL END as mcr,
    CASE WHEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric) > 0 AND CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric) > 0
      THEN CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix' AS numeric) / (SQRT(CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric)) * CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric)) * 0.01
      ELSE NULL END as tdi,
    CAST(m.mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm' AS numeric) as geom_accuracy
  FROM mesh m
),

reg AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.zoneref,
    CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm' AS numeric) as reg_accuracy_mm,
    CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm' AS numeric) as err_val_mm
  FROM registration r 
  JOIN scans sc ON r.arcref = sc.arcref
),

-- Aggregate all metrics per site
site_pc AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(sce) as avg_sce, AVG(scan_resol_mm) as avg_scan_resol, AVG(point_dense) as avg_point_dense, AVG(noise_db) as avg_noise_db FROM pc GROUP BY zoneref
),
site_mesh AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(mcr * (tdi/10.0) * (1+EXP(-geom_accuracy))) as avg_mfs FROM mesh WHERE mcr IS NOT NULL AND tdi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref
),
site_reg AS (
  SELECT zoneref, AVG(reg_accuracy_mm) as avg_reg_acc, AVG(err_val_mm) as avg_err_val FROM reg GROUP BY zoneref
),

-- Combine
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry as zref,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_sce, 0) as avg_sce,
    COALESCE(sm.avg_mfs, 0) as avg_mfs,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_scan_resol, 1) as avg_scan_resol,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_point_dense, 1) as avg_point_dense,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_noise_db, 0) as avg_noise_db,
    COALESCE(sr.avg_reg_acc, 1) as avg_reg_acc,
    COALESCE(sr.avg_err_val, 0) as avg_err_val
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN site_pc sp ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN site_mesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN site_reg sr ON s.zoneregistry = sr.zoneref
),

-- Compute SRI
sri_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_point_dense > 1 AND LOG10(avg_point_dense) != 0
      THEN LOG10(avg_scan_resol * 1000.0) / LOG10(avg_point_dense) * 5
      ELSE NULL END as sri
  FROM combined
),

-- Compute SQS
sqs_calc AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    CASE WHEN sr.sri IS NOT NULL AND sr.sri > 0
      THEN POWER(10.0/sr.sri, 1.5) * (c.avg_sce/100.0) * POWER(1 - c.avg_noise_db/30.0, 2)
      ELSE NULL END as sqs
  FROM combined c LEFT JOIN sri_calc sr ON c.zref = sr.zref
),

-- Compute RAR
rar_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_reg_acc > 0
      THEN avg_scan_resol / (avg_reg_acc * SQRT(1 + avg_err_val/avg_reg_acc))
      ELSE NULL END as rar
  FROM combined
),

-- Compute ADC
adc_calc AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    (COALESCE(sq.sqs, 0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) - 5*SQRT(c.avg_noise_db/10.0) as adc
  FROM combined c LEFT JOIN sqs_calc sq ON c.zref = sq.zref
),

-- Compute DPQ
dpq_calc AS (
  SELECT a.zref,
    (0.3*a.adc) + (0.3*a.avg_mfs) + (0.2*COALESCE(r.rar, 0)) + (0.2*a.avg_sce) - 2*SQRT(a.avg_err_val/a.avg_scan_resol) as dpq
  FROM adc_calc a LEFT JOIN rar_calc r ON a.zref = r.zref
)

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(CAST(d.dpq AS NUMERIC), 2) AS dpq
FROM dpq_calc d JOIN sites s ON d.zref = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY d.dpq DESC;

    CASE WHEN CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric) > 0 AND CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric) > 0
      THEN CAST(mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix' AS numeric) / (SQRT(CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS numeric)) * CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS numeric)) * 0.01
      ELSE NULL END as tdi,
    CAST(mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm' AS numeric) as geom_accuracy
  FROM mesh
),
reg AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
    CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm' AS numeric) as reg_accuracy_mm,
    CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm' AS numeric) as err_val_mm
  FROM registration r JOIN scans sc ON r.arcref = sc.arcref
),
site_pc AS (SELECT zoneref, AVG(sce) as avg_sce, AVG(scan_resol_mm) as avg_scan_resol, AVG(point_dense) as avg_point_dense, AVG(noise_db) as avg_noise_db FROM pc GROUP BY zoneref),
site_mesh AS (SELECT zoneref, AVG(mcr*(tdi/10.0)*(1+EXP(-geom_accuracy))) as avg_mfs FROM mesh WHERE mcr IS NOT NULL AND tdi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref),
site_reg AS (SELECT zoneref, AVG(reg_accuracy_mm) as avg_reg_acc, AVG(err_val_mm) as avg_err_val FROM reg GROUP BY zoneref),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry as zref,

    COALESCE(sr.avg_reg_acc,1) as avg_reg_acc, COALESCE(sr.avg_err_val,0) as avg_err_val
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN site_pc sp ON s.zoneregistry=sp.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN site_mesh sm ON s.zoneregistry=sm.zoneref LEFT JOIN site_reg sr ON s.zoneregistry=sr.zoneref
),
sri_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_point_dense > 1 AND LOG10(avg_point_dense) != 0
      THEN LOG10(avg_scan_resol * 1000.0) / LOG10(avg_point_dense) * 5
      ELSE NULL END as sri
  FROM combined
),
sqs_calc AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    CASE WHEN sr.sri IS NOT NULL AND sr.sri > 0
      THEN POWER(10.0/sr.sri, 1.5) * (c.avg_sce/100.0) * POWER(1 - c.avg_noise_db/30.0, 2)
      ELSE NULL END as sqs
  FROM combined c LEFT JOIN sri_calc sr ON c.zref=sr.zref
),
rar_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_reg_acc > 0
      THEN avg_scan_resol / (avg_reg_acc * SQRT(1 + avg_err_val/avg_reg_acc))
      ELSE NULL END as rar
  FROM combined
),
dpq_v3 AS (

  -- Let me try: ADC = SQS*0.4 + MFS*0.4 + SCE*0.2 (no noise term)
  SELECT c.zref,
    (COALESCE(sq.sqs,0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) as adc_no_noise,
    c.avg_mfs, c.avg_sce, c.avg_err_val, c.avg_scan_resol,
    COALESCE(r.rar, 0) as rar_val
  FROM combined c
  LEFT JOIN sqs_calc sq ON c.zref = sq.zref
  LEFT JOIN rar_calc r ON c.zref = r.zref
),
final_dpq AS (
  SELECT zref,
    (0.3*adc_no_noise) + (0.3*avg_mfs) + (0.2*rar_val) + (0.2*avg_sce) - 2*SQRT(avg_err_val/avg_scan_resol) as dpq
  FROM dpq_v3
)

FROM final_dpq f JOIN sites s ON f.zref = s.zoneregistry ORDER BY f.dpq DESC LIMIT 5;

WITH 
pc_agg AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
    AVG(CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS real) * (1 + (CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct' AS real)/100) * (1 - CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct' AS real)/100))) as avg_sce,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm' AS real), 1.0)) as avg_scan_resol,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense' AS bigint), 1000)::real) as avg_point_dense,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db' AS real), 0.0)) as avg_noise_db
  FROM pointcloud p JOIN scans sc ON p.arcref = sc.arcref
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref
),
mesh_agg AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    AVG(
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS real), 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS real), 0) > 0
        THEN (CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS real) / (CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts' AS real) * POWER(CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS real), 2)) * 1000)
          * ((CAST(mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix' AS real) / (SQRT(CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces' AS real)) * CAST(mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm' AS real)) * 0.01) / 10.0)
          * (1 + EXP(-CAST(mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm' AS real)))
        ELSE NULL END
    ) as avg_mfs
  FROM mesh
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
reg_agg AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm' AS real), 1.0)) as avg_reg_acc,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm' AS real), 0.0)) as avg_err_val
  FROM registration r JOIN scans sc ON r.arcref = sc.arcref
  GROUP BY sc.zoneref
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry as zref,
    COALESCE(pa.avg_sce, 0) as avg_sce,
    COALESCE(ma.avg_mfs, 0) as avg_mfs,
    pa.avg_scan_resol,
    pa.avg_point_dense,
    pa.avg_noise_db,
    ra.avg_reg_acc,
    ra.avg_err_val
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN pc_agg pa ON s.zoneregistry = pa.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN mesh_agg ma ON s.zoneregistry = ma.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN reg_agg ra ON s.zoneregistry = ra.zoneref
),
sri_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_point_dense > 1 AND LN(avg_point_dense) != 0
      THEN LN(avg_scan_resol * 1000.0) / LN(avg_point_dense) * 5
      ELSE NULL END as sri
  FROM combined
),
sqs_calc AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    CASE WHEN sr.sri IS NOT NULL AND sr.sri > 0
      THEN POWER(10.0/sr.sri, 1.5) * (c.avg_sce/100.0) * POWER(1 - c.avg_noise_db/30.0, 2)
      ELSE NULL END as sqs
  FROM combined c LEFT JOIN sri_calc sr ON c.zref=sr.zref
),
rar_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_reg_acc > 0
      THEN avg_scan_resol / (avg_reg_acc * SQRT(1 + avg_err_val/avg_reg_acc))
      ELSE NULL END as rar
  FROM combined
),
dpq_calc AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    (COALESCE(sq.sqs, 0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) - 5*SQRT(GREATEST(0.0, COALESCE(c.avg_noise_db, 0.0)/10.0)) as adc,
    c.avg_mfs, c.avg_sce, COALESCE(c.avg_err_val, 0.0) as avg_err_val, COALESCE(c.avg_scan_resol, 1.0) as avg_scan_resol,
    COALESCE(r.rar, 0) as rar_val
  FROM combined c
  LEFT JOIN sqs_calc sq ON c.zref = sq.zref
  LEFT JOIN rar_calc r ON c.zref = r.zref
),
final_dpq AS (
  SELECT zref,
    (0.3*adc) + (0.3*avg_mfs) + (0.2*rar_val) + (0.2*avg_sce) - 2*SQRT(avg_err_val/avg_scan_resol) as dpq
  FROM dpq_calc
)

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(CAST(f.dpq AS NUMERIC), 2) AS dpq
FROM final_dpq f JOIN sites s ON f.zref = s.zoneregistry ORDER BY f.dpq DESC;

site_pc AS (SELECT zoneref, AVG(sce) as avg_sce, AVG(scan_resol_mm) as avg_scan_resol, AVG(point_dense) as avg_point_dense, AVG(noise_db) as avg_noise_db FROM pc GROUP BY zoneref),
site_mesh AS (SELECT zoneref, AVG(mcr*(tdi/10.0)*(1+EXP(-geom_accuracy))) as avg_mfs FROM mesh WHERE mcr IS NOT NULL AND tdi IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref),
site_reg AS (SELECT zoneref, AVG(reg_accuracy_mm) as avg_reg_acc, AVG(err_val_mm) as avg_err_val FROM reg GROUP BY zoneref),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry as zref,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_sce, 0) as avg_sce, COALESCE(sm.avg_mfs, 0) as avg_mfs,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_scan_resol, 1) as avg_scan_resol, COALESCE(sp.avg_point_dense, 1) as avg_point_dense,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_noise_db, 0) as avg_noise_db,
    COALESCE(sr.avg_reg_acc, 1) as avg_reg_acc, COALESCE(sr.avg_err_val, 0) as avg_err_val
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN site_pc sp ON s.zoneregistry=sp.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN site_mesh sm ON s.zoneregistry=sm.zoneref LEFT JOIN site_reg sr ON s.zoneregistry=sr.zoneref
),
sri_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_point_dense > 1 AND LN(avg_point_dense) != 0
      THEN LN(avg_scan_resol * 1000.0) / LN(avg_point_dense) * 5
      ELSE NULL END as sri
  FROM combined
),
sqs_calc AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    CASE WHEN sr.sri IS NOT NULL AND sr.sri > 0
      THEN POWER(10.0/sr.sri, 1.5) * (c.avg_sce/100.0) * POWER(1 - c.avg_noise_db/30.0, 2)
      ELSE NULL END as sqs
  FROM combined c LEFT JOIN sri_calc sr ON c.zref=sr.zref
),
rar_calc AS (
  SELECT zref,
    CASE WHEN avg_reg_acc > 0
      THEN avg_scan_resol / (avg_reg_acc * SQRT(1 + avg_err_val/avg_reg_acc))
      ELSE NULL END as rar
  FROM combined
),
dpq_with_greatest AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    (COALESCE(sq.sqs, 0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) - 5*SQRT(GREATEST(0.0, c.avg_noise_db/10.0)) as adc,
    c.avg_mfs, c.avg_sce, c.avg_err_val, c.avg_scan_resol,
    COALESCE(r.rar, 0) as rar_val,
    (0.3*((COALESCE(sq.sqs, 0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) - 5*SQRT(GREATEST(0.0, c.avg_noise_db/10.0)))) + (0.3*c.avg_mfs) + (0.2*COALESCE(r.rar, 0)) + (0.2*c.avg_sce) - 2*SQRT(GREATEST(0.0, c.avg_err_val/c.avg_scan_resol)) as dpq_greatest
  FROM combined c
  LEFT JOIN sqs_calc sq ON c.zref = sq.zref
  LEFT JOIN rar_calc r ON c.zref = r.zref
),
dpq_without_greatest AS (
  SELECT c.zref,
    (COALESCE(sq.sqs, 0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) - 5*SQRT(c.avg_noise_db/10.0) as adc,
    c.avg_mfs, c.avg_sce, c.avg_err_val, c.avg_scan_resol,
    COALESCE(r.rar, 0) as rar_val,
    (0.3*((COALESCE(sq.sqs, 0)*0.4) + (c.avg_mfs*0.4) + (c.avg_sce*0.2) - 5*SQRT(c.avg_noise_db/10.0))) + (0.3*c.avg_mfs) + (0.2*COALESCE(r.rar, 0)) + (0.2*c.avg_sce) - 2*SQRT(c.avg_err_val/c.avg_scan_resol) as dpq_no_greatest
  FROM combined c
  LEFT JOIN sqs_calc sq ON c.zref = sq.zref
  LEFT JOIN rar_calc r ON c.zref = r.zref
)

SELECT w.zref, ROUND(w.dpq_greatest::numeric, 4) as with_g, ROUND(d.dpq_no_greatest::numeric, 4) as without_g
FROM dpq_with_greatest w
JOIN dpq_without_greatest d ON w.zref = d.zref
WHERE ROUND(w.dpq_greatest::numeric, 4) != ROUND(d.dpq_no_greatest::numeric, 4)
LIMIT 10;
